Anger is a symptom if something in your body going wrong. It can be a physical/nutrition problem, psychological, or both.

Heres how I beat my (albiet minor) anger issues:

-I started taking a multi-vitamin. Nothing special, just a generic one.

-I removed sources of drama from my life. That included several friends, facebook, and even a decent job.

-I start my day by meditating for about 5 minutes. Just long enough to focus on my breathing, and take mental inventory of where Im at.

-I use breathing exercises when Im angry in the moment, and realize that the anger will pass if I can be paitent for just a few seconds.

As you start to manage anger attacks with grace, you actually start to rewire your brains reward systems. Ive learned a deep sense of satisfaction by not giving away my self control, and I find at times I actually have to fight off laughing in somones face more being angry.

The wiki page for operant conditioning has a useful graph for explaining all of the above.

Good luck beating the rage!

Edit: I almost forgot a big one: stimulants. Everything from caffiene to meth will amp up your emotions, and will likely make things far worse during withdrawals. The only stim I consume is caffiene now, and only before noon.
